anomalies.expected: A step-up (boost) regulator is required to generate +12V from +5V, or the input should be a higher voltage.

anomalies.impact: The +12V rail will not be generated correctly; the regulator cannot step up 5V to 12V, so the +12V rail will be at or below 5V, affecting the alarm and any other +12V loads.
